summary: Accessible file list with checkbox selection and consumer-provided actions; it does not upload, download, or send files.
whenToUse: Showing already available documents with metadata and contextual actions.
Allowing single or multiple selection in a file list.
whenNotToUse: Choosing or uploading local files: use FileUpload.
Browsing folder hierarchies: use TreeView or a dedicated file browser.

props.name: files
props.description: Files to display with required id and name; description, size, and date are optional.

props.name: selectedIds / defaultSelectedIds
props.description: Controlled or initial selection based on file ids.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Receives the updated list of selected ids.

props.name: renderActions
props.description: Returns consumer-controlled actions for each file.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when files is empty.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the list.

inherits: FileManagerFile: { id: string; name: string; description?: string; size?: string; modified?: string }.

keyboard.action: Reaches the selection controls and the consumer-provided actions.
Selects or deselects the file when the checkbox has focus.

accessibility: The list has an accessible name and each checkbox is named after its file.
Actions passed via renderActions remain regular keyboard-reachable controls.
Selection is not conveyed by color alone and can be controlled by the application.
responsive: Long names and metadata wrap; on narrow viewports actions move to a new line.
customization: renderActions lets you provide buttons or menus managed by the consumer.
commonMistakes: Expecting uploads, downloads, or network requests: all operations remain the consumer's responsibility.
limits: No file system, upload, download, or network handling.
Does not include shift-click multiple selection or virtualized navigation.
